answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 411 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the haven. The marble index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the opal queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 147 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
